evidence.quote: Non-EU candidates who receive the letter of eligibility for enrolment in a bachelor’s or master’s degree program must complete the pre-enrolment procedure by logging in to the Universitaly portal and filling in the application online.

notes: 1) Tuition: the accepted figures come from the university-wide non-EU flat-tax page (a.y. 2025/2026) applied to the non-EU country category. Morocco is not named in any country list on the pages, and the degree programme "Economics and Business" is not tied to any fee group or table, so the flat tax for non-EU students from "all other countries" (not OECD, not Low Human Development Countries) is used: 1,300 EUR/year for a Bachelor's degree, stated to include regional tax and 16 EUR stamp duty. 2) Deadline: the pre-enrolment deadline of 30 September 2026 on Universitaly is for the 2026/2027 academic year (see quote "by 30 September 2026" and "The deadline for sending the application on Universitaly for 2026/2027 academic year has been set on September 30th, 2026."); this is a pre-enrolment/visa procedure deadline, not a programme application deadline, so no intake entry was emitted. 3) The programme has "limited admission" and applications open on 17 December 2025 for 2026/2027; multiple admission rounds exist depending on citizenship (apply.unive.it). 4) The requirement rules marked manual_check are informational; none has a numeric threshold. 5) Some quoted documents come from the portal apply.unive.it, where the applicant uploads them as tasks; translations are required if originals are not in English or Italian.

evidence.quote: Applicants for bachelor’s degree programmes must have obtained a secondary school diploma after having completed at least 12 years of schooling.

note.fr: Un test d'admission est requis pour ce programme à accès limité : vérifiez le format et les modalités auprès de l'université.
note.en: An entry test is required for this limited-admission programme: check the format and arrangements with the university.

note.fr: Prérequis linguistiques (anglais et/ou italien) : le niveau précis est indiqué sur la page du programme.
note.en: Language requirements (English and/or Italian): the exact level is stated on the programme's web page.

evidence.quote: English language certificate AND/OR Italian language certificate: level and requirements are specified on the specific course’s web page on unive.it;

note.fr: Frais de candidature de 30 euros, non remboursables ; des exemptions existent (voir le portail apply.unive.it).
note.en: Non-refundable 30-euro application fee; exemptions exist (see apply.unive.it portal).

evidence.quote: In order to apply for admission to Ca’ Foscari, international students need to pay an application fee of 30 euros.

note.fr: Le tarif dépend de la nationalité et de la résidence : vérifier votre catégorie de frais sur la page des frais de scolarité.
note.en: The fee depends on nationality and residence: verify your fee category on the tuition fees page.

evidence.quote: If you are a student with non-EU citizenship, who enrolled for the 2025/2026 academic year in a bachelor’s degree or master’s degree are subject to the payment of a flat tax.
